newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises one point to 739.8 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises one point to 739.8 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose one point on Friday to 739.8 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices rose, with the investment fund index rising the most, up 28.1 points to 1,125.3.
Five indices lost, with the banking index losing the most, down eight points to 1,107.8.
